xBRIEFInfo.description: feedback:file repeated --context flags must accumulate instead of last-wins.

narratives.Description: fix(cli): repeated --context flags on feedback:file accumulate instead of last-wins. The existing context string schema stays a string by joining collected values at parse or render time.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3454. Split from #3437. Operator swarm 2026-08-18 through-merge cohort with #3470 and #3469. Do not close #3437.
narratives.Overview:
`feedback:file` repeated `--context` flags silently keep only the last value. Location: packages/core/src/value/feedback-file.ts:353-356 — `out.context = argv[++i]` (and the `--context=` branch) assign a scalar.

Preferred fix: collect values and join with newlines (or `; `) at parse or render time so the existing `context?: string` schema stays a string. Alternative: fail closed with `argument --context: specified multiple times`.

Out of scope: the #3437 dry-run honesty gap; changing --summary / --expected / --actual / --notes repeat semantics unless they share the same helper. Do not close #3437.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator filing feedback with two --context flags, I want both values in the filed issue body, so that the last flag does not silently drop the first.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Accumulate --context and --context= into an array; join at parse or render. 2. Keep context?: string schema. 3. Test two flags (space-separated and --context=) in feedback-file.test.ts near the existing --context case (~line 218). 4. CHANGELOG. Closes #3454 only. ⊗ Close #3437.

narrative.Acceptance: Given `task feedback:file --context a --context b` (and the `--context=` form), when argv is parsed, then both values are kept (joined) rather than last-wins.
